title: The Last Reunion
description:
The Last Reunion is an AI-powered deduction game where a joyful reunion ends in tragedy. 

You play as a police officer investigating a murder that occurred during a house party. 

Explore the crime scene from a first-person perspective, interact with objects, and uncover hidden clues. 

Interrogate NPCs powered by ChatGPT, each designed with a unique personality, backstory, and secrets. 

Your investigation influences the storyline, and each suspect leads to a different ending. 

Replay the game to discover new evidence and uncover the full truth behind Alan’s death.

Key Features:

- Immersive first-person investigation gameplay

- ChatGPT-integrated NPCs that respond based on unique personas

- Interactive crime scene exploration and evidence collection

- Multi-ending structure shaped by player choices

- Story-driven gameplay set in a single location with dynamic interrogation

[Tips for Playing The Last Reunion]

1️⃣ Pay close attention to each character’s reaction. 

      The more sensitive the response, the more likely your question is tied to the case. 

2️⃣ Gather as much evidence as possible first. 

      This will help you build a solid overall picture of the incident. 

3️⃣ Every character will eventually tire. 

      The more you interrogate, the more hidden truths will come out. 

4️⃣ Think carefully before asking questions. 

      The wrong approach may lead to strange or misleading answers. 

5️⃣ Evidence is more than just an item. 

      You need to connect it with other clues when questioning.

 

👉 Experience it yourself now in *The Last Reunion*!
description_short: A mystery game where you investigate a murder by searching the crime scene and interrogating AI-powered NPCs with unique personas.
